kind: derived documentation, not a file export
statement: No bytes were copied from any source into this directory. AS_BUILT.md and REV_A_INTERFACES.md were written from the sources listed below, which are recorded with their revisions, paths, blob ids and hashes so every assertion can be traced. Hardware design content (circuit values, connections, pinouts) originates with the owner and the historical engineering sessions; this return consolidates and reviews it and claims no circuit authorship.

prepared_by.session_id_basis: Read from this session's harness-assigned working paths. This tool exposes no session/thread environment pair to cross-check it against, so the identity is single-sourced rather than independently verified.

destination_base.rebase_note: The manager advanced main during this work with the LRA-04 dispatch update and the October 29 inventory clarification. Neither touches logger/hardware/as-built/, and the repository_sources hashes below are unchanged between the two commits.

historical_source.access: A checkout of this repository is present on the development host at /srv/agent_share/pcb. Every read was performed with 'git show <rev>:<path>' pinned to the commit above, so the checkout's own working tree (which carries unrelated uncommitted deletions belonging to another session, and whose HEAD is 705b068) did not influence any quotation. Nothing in that repository was modified, staged or committed.

files.consulted_for: Dated as-built corrections and installation records: 1N5819 clamp correction and corrected divider table (Oct 24), C14 measured branch current and GP4 toggle verification (Oct 23), GP5 power-off quantification (Oct 24), ignition rewired to cluster B11/B16 (Oct 26), 5 V branch current (Oct 26), tach/VSS measurements (Oct 15), ignition cell derived from keyless U13 (Oct 16)
Cluster A/B/C connector map and the already-tapped table; its B11/B16 'specified, not pulled' status is superseded (conflict C-04)
ADC channel assignment, divider values and ratios, per-channel protection, divider placement and single-point grounding, measured leakage result

Installation and ground-topology entries only: fuel divider fitted, B11/B16 connected, DMM calibration point, B16 ground rail confirmation. Personal fuel, fill, gauge and odometer records were read and deliberately not transported
Section 5.1 pin assignments and section 5.2 as-built SD wiring, measurements, rail-change gate and 3V3 current-budget caveat
Current pin constants, 12-bit ADC configuration, published divider resistors and header facts; its header comment's cell description is stale (conflicts C-01, C-02)
Card header format: log.pins and log.adc.* fields, and the absence of any series-resistance term
As-built SPI0 pin map, 12 MHz clock and the 3V3(OUT) rail rationale
Candidate GP6 HOLD writer, 4 mA drive strength and LOW preload
Current public summary of the recorded baseline and the LRA-01/02 candidate conflicts
Section 6 off-state/backfeed audit and illustrative injection currents
Candidate domains, pins, startup and shutdown contract, parked-current allocations, off-state isolation table and the LRA-03 interface selection gate
Conditional component selections, parked ledger and the 10/25 microamp interface reservation
Published meaning of the header tags this proposal must not break
Reference blocks only: U13/R12/D4/C12 ignition cell, U10-U12 ground-active cells, LM2678 supply, TP1-TP7 test points and J7 reset header, J1/J2 connectors
Confirms the keyless ignition cell is read active-low on GP14 with INPUT_PULLUP and no external collector pull-up
Known keyless validation exceptions to read before extracting any value: J2 absent from the PCB, R14/R15 value differences

Every derived number asserted in the two documents
validation.result: 70 arithmetic checks pass. Corrections made during authoring and review: three initial mismatches (supply/DMM difference -43.7 mV, fuel +21.2 mV, powered-rail clamp model); then, per manager review R03-REV-2 and R03-REV-3, the ADC filter poles were recomputed including the fitted 1k (40.92/32.66 Hz, not 55.1/41.1 Hz), the RP2040 VIH corrected to 2.0 V at IOVDD 3.3 V, and the edge-rejection headroom corrected to 46x

validation.check: Manager review R03-REV-1 through R03-REV-6 addressed
validation.result: All six findings accepted and applied. Two were substantive technical errors in the first return (the ADC filter model and the RP2040 VIH value); the rest were overclaims, stale fitted-status prose and reference repairs. No finding was disputed
